notes.title: In-game Character Selection & QoL Fixes
notes.content:
You can now choose your character skin in-game by going to Options > Character.
Added a “Don’t Show Again” button for the PVP warning when entering a PVP world.
Pals now rotate to face the direction they’re walking, and if they’re close to their target, they’ll rotate to face the target instead.
Exit to Main Menu is now the last option in the in-game options menu.

notes.title: Major Stability & Performance Update
notes.content:
- Huge memory & RAM optimizations. Game runs smoother on all devices.
- Fixed server lag which was especially bad when depositing large amounts of items into the bank.
- “Deposit All” is now nearly instant.
- Fixed duplicate PowDex notifications (no more double messages on drops).
- ESC now properly closes UI windows again.

notes.title: Performance & Item Stability Fixes
notes.content:
- Uses less memory, so the game runs better on all devices.
- Improved how item and Pal data are stored to keep everything correctly linked.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Skate jumps over cliffs and water no longer glitch out.
[*] PowBucks from hatched Pals now stack correctly in your inventory.
[*] Hatched items are properly recorded as fully collected in the PowDex.
[*] Space bar works again for quick bank deposits and withdrawals.
[*] Quest cutscenes won’t repeat from spam-clicking or pressing space.
[*] Opening chat during cutscenes no longer causes them to stall.
[*] Tentacle Thugs quest cutscene now finishes as expected.
[*] Fixed a friends list issue that caused UI errors.
[/list]

notes.title: Polish and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- Pals now properly travel and gather resources.
- Pressing ESC will now close any open UI, just like clicking the X.
- When at 0 HP, players can no longer can use teleports, activate items, drop items, or equip/unequip gear. Previously, these actions were still possible despite being 0 HP.
- Fixed an issue where clicking “Exit to Main Menu” during a skate event brought up a confirmation prompt that froze player movement and left you stuck on an unwalkable tile.

notes.title: "Make X" for All Skills + UI Clarity Improvements
notes.content:
Added “Make X” support for Smith, Smelt, Pack, Cut, Craft, Disintegrate, and Sacrifice. These now process all matching items with one click.

Skill Guides UI now expands on wide screens, showing all categories that fit on screen. This should help players easily find recipes like “sticks” when training the Steel skill.

Pal UI now has Health Bar and Current Task sections swapped to make task assignment clearer.

Main Menu Character Shop now shows a live countdown to the daily reset.

Eggs now gain progress from tiles traveled during skate jumps.

notes.title: Critical Bug Fixes & Performance Improvements
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that caused players—especially those on EU devices—to get stuck in an infinite loading screen when entering the world on Steam.  
- Fixed an issue where other players' chat messages would stop appearing above their heads after about 10 minutes of conversation. Messages still appeared in the chat window but no longer showed in-world.
- Fixed a server lag issue caused when players with very large banks (e.g., @marchontwitch :ogchickenhoodie:) withdrew items, causing noticeable performance drops.
- Fixed a bug where Pals could place gold into a secondary inventory slot, creating two separate stacks of the same item. This wasn’t a duplication issue, but it caused confusion.

notes.title: Worlds and PvP
notes.content:
- Worlds can now be PvP ON or PvP OFF. PvP worlds allow player combat. Non-PvP worlds are safe from player combat.
- New friends menu added. You can now add/remove friends and see who’s online and what world they’re in.
- New options menu added with access to PowDex, PowPass, Friends, and Exit to Menu.

notes.title: Earth and Steel skills are here!
notes.content:
- Rocks are now scattered around Pow Vista, ready to be mined for ore. Use the ore to craft items!
- New Wateroth creatures have washed ashore near the Torrey Village docks.
- Embermaw and Skelefriend now have a chance to drop eggs (1/100 and 1/5000 chance, respectively)
